exactSourceStatements: Inscribed in 2022 (17.COM) on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity
The oud is a traditional, lute-type instrument played in Iran and Syria.
They typically have five twin strings, though a sixth string can be added.
In both countries, the oud consists of a pear-shaped sound box made of walnut, rose, poplar, ebony or apricot wood.
